d: The crew is hired to rescue a princess from a notorious outlaw, but it is soon revealed that she was trying to escape murder at her father's hand.
Dylan is arrested and tried by the Collectors and Triumvirs for high crimes against the Commonwealth.
The crew intercepts a smuggler's stash of mysterious living armor on its way to a war-torn galaxy.
Transported to an alternate reality, Dylan finds that Harper's evil counterpart has overthrown the Commonwealth.
The Andromeda gets caught in a war between two ships -- and it includes a fatal disease.
The Collectors use Rev Bem, a former crew member, as bait to lure Dylan into a life-or-death situation.
The Abyss has infected Beka. The crew must find a way to save her.
After some of the crew is captured, Harper is forced to work on a time bridge for the Patriarch.
A spy from Tri Gemma shows up on the Andromeda in an attempt to steal the star map.
While the crew is being attacked by the Magog, Andromeda fails to respond to Rommie's direction because it has severed its connection with her.
Agents wearing medallions of the Abyss murder a true Collector aboard the Maru because they want to find a hidden library.
Andromeda rescues a ship returning from peace talks with the Magog.
The Magog attack has dire consequences. The Andromeda is destroyed, Trance and Dylan are presumed the only survivors and Dylan escapes into the route of ages.
Dylan ends up on Seefra, where the superstitious population has no technology.
Dylan and Rhade (Steve Bacic) pick up a distress signal from Beka, only to find her scheming with a trade mogul who has claimed Andromeda for himself.
A scientist bent on creating a new Vedran Age uses a purple mist and a "nanobot" to control would-be genetic donors.
It turns out Doyle is an android, built by Harper to contain Rommie's core programming.
Beka wins a prize from a radio DJ, learns the truth about Seefra and locates the Meethus Diagram.
A mysterious stranger who holds the link between the past and Seefra's troubled present pursues Dylan.
Flavin returns, sparking a gang war, and helps Dylan develop as a Paradine.
A crystal that can restore the Andromeda's power is discovered, but in order to get it, Dylan must work for the mine's owner.
Trance's misadventure into Seefra-1's tunnel system exposes the guardian of an ancient Vedran secret.
When an old man is killed, Beka, Rhade and Harper are the main suspects and stand trial.
Rhade leads the rebels in battle against a warlord on Seefra-5.
Dylan discovers that Beka's boyfriend was really Drago Musevini, and he used Beka's DNA to create the Nietzscheans.
Beka and Rhade find a test that will either grant them great wealth or drive them to madness.
Trance's sun looms on the edge of the system, threatening to destroy all of Seefra unless the Vedran design can be mended.
While Harper works on a way to save the Seefra system, a spy sneaks aboard Andromeda and attacks Beka.
An attempt is made to fix the blinking sun of Seefra, but Trance is replaced by a doppelganger.
When Dylan is badly injured in a lab explosion, he travels through a series of alternate realities.
Rommie turns on the crew after she is rebuilt to help evacuate Seefra's planets.
A warlord convinces his followers that the approaching destruction of the outer planets is a plot to make it easier to loot their planet.
Dylan, Rhade and Beka work together to rescue Trance from Methus-2 and Harper from General Burma.
After being left stranded near a black hole, Captain Dylan Hunt is discovered by a mercenary salvage ship.
Dylan protects the Andromeda from mercenaries while Beka starts to wonder if they are fighting for the wrong side.
Dylan finds a space station full of kids who believe he is there to bring peace by killing their enemies.
During a fight with an enemy, Dylan has some dissension within the ranks as Beka and Tyr question his leadership.
The Nietzscheans try to lure Tyr into their fold with promises of a wife if he will help them defeat the Andromeda.
A slipstream sends the Andromeda back in time to just before the Commonwealth falls. The crew must intervene to preserve history.
Beka's brother shows up claiming to be a devout Wayist, making the Andromeda a prime target for Restorian attack.
Capt. Hunt (Kevin Sorbo) is reunited with his long-lost love (guest star Sam Jenkins Sorbo) after a 300-year separation. With Gordon Michael Woolvett, Lisa Ryder, Keith Hamilton Cobb and Brent Stait.
Dylan is imprisoned on a prison planet and must stage an escape as his crew tries to stage their own rescue.
Castalians board the Andromeda to finalize the charter for the New Commonwealth. When the leader is discovered dead, Tyr is the main suspect.
Beka learns that her father's former business partner deals in a highly addictive drug called F lash.
The Andromeda discovers her sister ship, the Pax Magellanic. The crew aboard Pax is 300 years old...but have not aged a day.
Tyr crash-lands the Eureka Maru on a Nietzschean planet and develops amnesia. He must remember what he is doing before the Nietzscheans discover him and his crate of stolen goods.
Harper receives the gift of knowledge from a dying Perseid, only to discover that the Perseid was being sought by a bounty hunter who has now turned his attention to Harper.
Captured Dylan must admit he overthrew the Möbius government and killed its leader more than 300 years earlier.
Andromeda is boarded by a drone from the Consensus of Parts, a mythical mechanical society. While friendly at first, the drone tries to force the ship to join the Consensus.
Trance, Harper and their former employer, Gerentex, are unwilling partners on a wild ride to find a valuable artifact.
Dylan and Rev Bem help a peaceful society to stand up to their would-be slavers, but they have to be careful: if Dylan teaches them to kill, their kids will be born knowing it.
Dylan attempts to bring peace to two different Nietzschean prides by escorting the princess of one to her arranged marriage to the prince of the other.
Rommie's avatar falls in love with what turns out to be the avatar of a warship named Gabriel. Gabriel attempts to infect Rommie with a virus that broadcasts its plans to the warship.
Beka takes the Andromeda to Tarn-Vedra, but extended time in the slipstream causes side effects. To combat them, Beka starts taking Flash and soon becomes addicted.
An old memory from the Andromeda is accidentally activated, which sends her on a mission and leaves Dylan alongside the crew unable to override the command.
With the ship severely damaged, Dylan leads the crew of the Andromeda Ascendant in a battle against its deadliest enemy.
Dylan, Beka, Rev and Tyr crash land after escaping a gang of Nietzscheans, but soon face a new threat: Rev's need to feed.
The crew must steal a jewel that is at the center of a feud between a Drift owner and the Than. Beka falls for a security chief who was formerly a thief.
Trance is held captive, while Dylan and the rest of the crew try to uncover the source behind mysterious attacks on cargo ships.
The crew seeks Isabella Ortiz, a leader whose people were destroyed by the Kalderans, in a mining outpost bar.
Dylan, Beka and Trance go with Rommie to find out about a weapon being developed on a planet that distrusts AI.
Beka is stranded in a damaged Maru; Dylan and Tyr try to neutralize an enemy command center; Harper guides the ship through Nietzschean territory to deliver medical supplies.
A planet of Commonwealth survivors led by Dylan's former fiancee is invited to join the new Commonwealth.
A conference of Commonwealth allies takes place on the ship, while a plot forms to gain access to the database.
When they rescue a prince from an uprising that kills his family, Dylan and Tyr are asked to be his advisors.
Dylan and his new Commonwealth fleet take on the Drago-Kazov fleet but find it much larger than expected.
The Magog eggs in Harper are starting to hatch, so the team builds a Teseract machine.
Dylan takes over a tourist barge in an attempt to escape mercenaries.
Beka receives news about an old friend and embarks on a quest to Cascada while reliving her troubled past.
Andromeda rescues dying people from a drift, but they soon turn into zombies being controlled by a hive-mind.
The engine of creation is capable of rewriting the universe according to the owner's wishes. Dylan, Beka and Trance must obtain it before someone with dark plans gets it.
A black hole knocks out Dylan and sends him into an alternative reality with a wife and child.
The crew rescues one of the long-lost founders of the Commonwealth, but discovers she may be more trouble than she is worth.
The crew of Andromeda encounters a creature called Cetus, once thought to be mythological.
Dylan attempts to liberate a fleet of captured ships, but the fleet isn't sure it wants to be liberated. Their AIs fear that new captains will enslave them.
Tyr races to save his wife and her colony from Genite attack and discovers he has a son who has been kidnapped.
With fifty parties on board, Dylan hosts the signing of the New Commonwealth charter, but soon discovers there are intruders intent on stopping the signing.
Beka and Tyr are taken over by the energy from a dimensional tunnel. Dylan, Trance and Harper must save them before they destroy the ship.
Dylan is framed for murder and must clear his name while finding the pieces of a vase said to grant the owner the "blessings of the cosmos.
The crew rescues a group of refugees, only to discover they have been subject to government experiments and are extremely unstable.
Beka's uncle runs for office in the New Commonwealth, but an assassination attempt causes the crew to act as his security.
When the Andromeda is attacked by space pirates, they are rescued by a long-lost spaceship from Earth.
The crew discovers that a rogue planet, Marduk, has been creating weapons of mass destruction.
A hitman by the name of the Leper is targeting the leaders of the New Commonwealth.
A crew member who died more than 300 years earlier haunts the Andromeda, which becomes infested with maggots.
When a long lost love returns, Tyr disappears from the ship to protect her from an assassin.
Set in an alternate universe where Dylan died and Gaheris Rhade is trying to reform the Commonwealth.
The group that attacked the Andromeda during the first Commonwealth charter signing returns to wreak more havoc.
Trance runs through a number of different scenarios, trying to find one in which her crewmates don't die.
